headline: THE RENA TOUR RAN AND SAID NOTHING — first provable live traffic at the list price in 88 days, no feedback filed, and the agreement dies at the end of TODAY with the number still unruled. · DO: text Kyle B. the lake answer — the answer was right but it went to the wrong Kyle at 10:00a · WATCH: The Daily still has not fired, now six hours past its slot, verified three ways.

A 2 is the lowest this listing has ever recorded, against a 4 three weeks earlier from an agent who called the price JUST RIGHT — the house did not get more expensive between those two visits, it got less presentable. 🔴 AND IT CORROBORATES AN ITEM THIS BOARD HAS CARRIED UNACTIONED FOR THREE WEEKS: the 7/23 read said dirty plus GLITCHING ELECTRICAL. A holding answer today beats a complete one next week, and a builder who gets no answer assumes the worst. ⚠️ THAT QUESTION IS THE GATE ON THE WHOLE PACKAGE — perc results decide buildability, buildability decides price per lot. 🔥 FOUR BUYER SIGNALS IN THREE DAYS WHILE EVERY OTHER AD IN THE PORTFOLIO PRODUCED ZERO, and both named land leads still have no call logged against them. ⚠️ Two builder outreach addresses are bouncing, so part of the builder audience for this package is receiving nothing at all. ⭐ Blocks and takedowns at a higher per-lot number remain acceptable per the seller's own ruling.
